why: Chris, 11 October 2026, picking the level emblems: four first-rank or rhino emblems to make again - clubweb 0 and catword 0 were a blank white page, sql9 0 carried text and sql9 3 was a paw print instead of a rhino's three-toed track.
style: A glossy 3D game rank emblem, smooth shiny enamel and metal, soft studio light, like a reward in a mobile game. The whole emblem centred on a plain pure white background with space all around it. No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos anywhere.

items.name: sql9-0
items.prompt: a single young acacia seedling with two small green leaves growing from red soil, set on a plain round bronze medal frame

items.name: sql9-3
items.prompt: a single white rhino footprint pressed into red sand: one large rounded pad with three broad rounded toes at the front like a clover, no claws, set on a round silver medal frame

items.name: clubweb-0
items.prompt: a single shiny coral-red toy building brick, set on a plain round bronze medal frame

items.name: catword-0
items.prompt: a fountain pen nib, set on a plain round bronze medal frame
